f1.speaker: sabu
f1.text: A samurai from off the page? Hah. Haven't seen one of you since the ink was wet.

f2.speaker: sabu
f2.text: You're here for the Weaver. Don't look surprised - the fox told everyone. He's been smiling about it for days.

f3.speaker: sabu
f3.text: Every night she stands in the surf and holds back the black water. Without her this shore drowns in a week. Whoever sent you knows that.

choices.text: Hana's looking for her papa, Jun. Have you seen him?
My master says she drowns boats for sport.
Is there another way off this shore?

f_ans.speaker: sabu
f_ans.text: Your master's never seen the sea, I'd wager.

f_way.speaker: sabu
f_way.text: There's an old shrine at the back of this net store, behind the drying racks. They say the shore's key rests there, for folk who lost theirs.

jun.speaker: sabu
jun.text: Jun. Best net-man on the shore and the worst singer in three tellings. He rowed out toward the cove the night the water turned black. Said he'd seen a light in it.

jun2.speaker: sabu
jun2.text: The cove's south of the square where the blobs nest. If the tide took him, it left something there. It always does.

charm.speaker: sabu
charm.text: That's Jun's charm. ...Take it to the girl. Tell her whatever you can live with. She'll know the truth eventually - kids always do.

again.speaker: sabu
again.text: The shrine's at the back if you need the shore's key. And mind the fox. He smiles too much for someone with no face.

post.speaker: sabu
post.text: Water's at my ankles in my own store. Kagami held it back three hundred years, and you held a sword for a few minutes.

choices.text: Who sent me, Sabu? What did he want with her light?

post_sorry.speaker: sabu
post_sorry.text: Sorry doesn't bail water. ...But it's a start. Go and see the girl before you go.

post_who.speaker: sabu
post_who.text: Something that eats light the way the sea eats boats. Something that can't make its own. Find out what's under that mask, samurai.
